name: Hoshitsuki Orihime
source: Patron of "YuKuRu" and an acquaintance of [url=/c66131]Inaho Shin[/url]. She works as a high school teacher and was the homeroom teacher of [url=/c67808]Chinatsu[/url]. Her students affectionately call her the name "Himechan-sensei." Despite closing in onto her 30's, her looks remain adolescent as ever; people call her the "Zashiki-warashi of Sumisora" in reverence of her eternal youth. She regularly goes to Marinland and is a fan of the children's anime "Let's Goー☆ Peta Peta."
